text: I found Addicted To The Bean on my way to the beach and I'm happy I did! It was empty in the morning and the staff was friendly and quick. I ordered an ice coffee with almond milk and it was refreshing!

Good food. Home cooking prolly won't ever visit again. Food is very rich in texture and taste. For myself, I knw I can't eat like this all the time. It was good. I would have gave a 5 star review but the covid messed up my experience as you call in your order and they bring them out.

The aromas alone are worth a visit to this little gem. We stopped by for a morning mocha and scones. A mocha with Monsoon chocolate, exceptional! Can't wait to go back for lunch and some fresh pasta and pesto to go. These ladies are true artisans!

Stopped by for lunch during our visit in Tucson AZ.  This place never disappoint.  Always serving the best Caramelos and Sonoran Hot Dog in town and in my humble opinion, the best anywhere.  I've been coming at this place since the mid 90's when it was just an order window and a hotdog cart after the last call at the 4th Ave bars.  It's as good today for lunch as it was at 2am in the morning, except you can find a place to sit due to a large cooled covered area.
I highly recommend the large Carne Asada Caramelo and chase it with a pair of Sonoran hotdog.  Don't forget to visit the salsa bar and grab a couple of roasted onion and peppers and finish it with your favorite cold cola drinks like an orange Fanta or a Manzanita.

Tried it 1 more time because I really really wanted it to be good.   "It's worse than a McDonalds burger now...this is the last Shake Shake I am ever going to have."  Ha, my husband is funny.  But true.  Burger was dry, soooooooo overcooked it was crispy.  I am sad. Shake Shake burgers are amazing, I don't understand what they do here to make them so bad, why they can't train the staff.

Always delicious! The noodle soup is my go-to was when I feel a cold coming on: amazing broth with garlic, ginger & plus protein, bean sprouts, cilantro, jalapeño & lime topping options- not too spicy, just right!

Our entire experience here was phenomenal! Everything we tried was so flavorful and delicious. To top off an already wonderful visit, we received exceptional customer service from Hans. He gave us excellent recommendations and was a delight to talk to. We left with happy stomachs and smiles on our faces. Thank you, Hans! Thank you Steam Boys! We are already planning our next visit!

Food was ok, service was subpar. Ordered the avocado chicken sub, waited 20 minutes for my sandwich (which was given to the wrong table) and then went asked, was told that they had forgotten to remake it. Other patrons seemed to be having the same problem. If you want to go, do not go when it is busy.

Good sando for my hungry mouth. Good falafel for my body and I ate the whole thing there in the restaurant alone in the corner trying not to make eye contact with anyone because I didn't feel like being judged for making such a mess with all the sauce dripping down my forearms but I'm not one to put my sando down until it's done so once I start I don't stop and I would love to return again for more falafel
Transplant from NJ where we have many great Italian restaurants. Johnny's is our go to for great Italian food here in Safety Harbor! They just remolded recently and it looks great!

Definitely a hidden gem.  Not from around here, could help but smell the goodness that made me want to stop. They were friendly, clean and most important the food was so good. Whenever I'm in town or driving through I will stop there again.

Update*
Maybe they were having an off day, but to characterize the review as fake is ridiculous. I have uploaded photos to prove that I purchased food from this restaurant AND received a refund. Further, I even called them on the day of and informed them that they should change their batter (I know what buttermilk is FYI). Like the owner said, make your own decision.

I will never step foot in this establishment. I was looking for a new brunch spot during the pandemic so ordered from here for delivery. This is the worst brunch in the city hands down. I had to request a full refund and immediately threw the breakfast in the trash. We had the Buttermilk Pancakes, Bourbon Glazed French Toast, Scrapple, O.T.'S Eggs scramble, and Side ofpotatoes. The problems.

There was a serious food quality issue, as in the freshness and safety of the food. The French toast tasted like old grease, it was dripping, and the cake inside tasted store bought. The pancakes had a strong sour taste as if the buttermilk was rancid. The scrapple was extremely mushy inside and finally, the egg dish was so watery we were questioning if they used powdered eggs. The potatoes were nothing to write home about. Do yourself a favor and avoid.
So the food is decent but we have been here twice and both times the service sucked! It took so long for anyone to even greet us and get our drinks order. Basically you'll be waiting around a lot!!!
This place is pretty good! The deadhead burger is NASTY,but the turkey burger is great! I recommend this place. Also the service is slow
It was a different unique cuisine. But in the end I thought it was very over priced and not as flavorful as I would have wished. Fun to go once and maybe happy hour. But I wouldn't go back hungry.

For me the food was just ok. I didn't opt for the cone, but I'm sure it wouldn't change the flavor much. I was expecting more from the grits, they were a little bland. The mac n cheese wasn't bad, chicken was average (a little salty) and the cauliflower tasted like - fried cauliflower. It all tasted like something I could have made at home. There was nothing that stood out in terms of flavor. I think the whole cone idea is what makes them unique. Overall I would still say try them for yourselves because it's not BAD food, but it's not rave worthy either.

This place was the perfect answer to a rainy day. My husband and I ordered dinner to go and got Beef Pho, chicken wings, spring rolls, and some Tiramisu for dessert.  The broth is really the most important part of Pho and determines what makes a good Pho shop, and this place passed the test. The broth was rich and flavorful. We heated it up a little more when we got home so it was really hot when we ate, and man, it really hit the spot.
The spring rolls and wings were good too, the tiramisu could be a pass. They did come in cute little glass cups though, which we have kept because they are the PERFECT whiskey sipping size!  

So overall, a win!

We visited this restaurant for the first time as we were staying in Tucson for a short vacations. We had no idea of what to expect. It was wonderful! The atmosphere, the food and the service! Just outstanding! We didn't sit at a teppanyaki table, they have at least 12, but we decided for a regular table. We were able to see the chefs at the teppanyaki tables and they were funny and people were enjoying themselves. We had scallops and shrimp with fried rice. The portions are generous and the food very tasty. We had at least 5 people taking care of us at different times, including the owner, who visits every table to give thanks for your visit. It was a great experience!

The GM lady and Miguel were badasses. They juggled a full bar,glassware up to their nostrils, and a ton of customers by the pool table like it was nothing. Thanks for the hospitality and fantastic margaritas .

The manager Jason was wonderful and terrific. There was a promo that was put out and it wasn't for all Applebee's. He honored it as a thank you to us being healthcare workers on the frontline. He was polite and understanding. 
The food is wonderful and we always have a great time here. I would recommend getting the oriental chicken salad. The dressing is tasty and the salad had the right amount of toppings.

Came here for our 11th year anniversary and it was amazing! The vibe is very romantic, service was exceptional and food was super tasty! We will definitely come back! Also there was a lively couple next to us the bought us wine and dessert for our special day and who we heard they come here often so if you ever get to see this, Thank you so much! You made our night much more special!  Your kind words and marriage advice will not be taken for granted! Thank you all!

Ordered their Chicken Parmesan Fettuccine Feast. Included pasta, Parmesan chicken, family salad with ranch dressing, garlic bread, brownies, and a pint of Vanilla ice cream. Everything was tasty. Food was still hot when I served it at home. The chicken Parmesan was tender and moist and had lots of seasoning and gooey melted cheese on top. The salad had lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, shredded carrots, and onion. Croutons were packaged on the side so they didn't get soggy mixed in with the salad. Plus there was plenty of ranch dressing to go around for everyone to have their own individual serving. Their famous bread was a bit dry but still tasty. On the whole the meal was satisfying and great, however being Italian, I would've preferred a bit more sauce on the fettuccine.
Dessert of their brownies and ice cream was a delicious finish to a great meal. Their brownies are soft and chewy and personally, I could probably eat a whole pan by myself! Five stars plus tonight for a great meal and as always, some of the most helpful, polite, friendly staff for ordering and picking up.

I LOVE THIS PLACE! 
 I don't go out alot but I'm always impressed with the food,service & especially the atmosphere! 
Love the mussels!!
Love the Oyster Rockefeller!

Nice diner. Good food and excellent service 
I sit at the counter occasionally and listen to this hostess/ owner? Small thin lady with a nasty attitude toward her staff. She appears to be an owner. Shame in her. I don't have to spend my money and listen to this biatch!

During this Rona, a lot of us that can afford to are ordering in support of local businesses and I'm definitely glad that I decided to order from this place! Anywho, the food came hot and delicious via Ubereats and me and my family were satisfied, especially my daughter. She ate everything off her plate, this is a hard feat for a picky toddler . I am not sure of the horrible reviews but the proof is in the pudding and I have just placed another to this place as I'm typing this lol . Y'all should definitely give them a try! Thank you Tiani's pizza for delicious eats!
My first time having a crunch wrap and a Doritos taco. They forgot the steak on my taco but that's okay. Simple Taco Bell no complaints here.

Cochon is open again! With the food just as delicious and memorable as before the covid closure, but with the new dining experience having tables a lot more spaced out and the staff wearing all the appropriate protection gear. It is advised to make a reservation ahead of your visit (you can do so right through their website), but our lunch reservation got us the dining room pretty much all to ourselves (additional tables are set up outside). I guess not everyone was as excited as we were for the opportunity to dine in (It will take time, I get it. But we appreciated the opportunity and the measures taken to make that opportunity possible.). Food wise, the fried Boudin and Fried Alligator were a must! And while every Cochon Daily Special is different, the Shishido Peppers that came with my neck/shoulder meat, were out of this world delicious (the restaurant is doing what they can to feature and utilize every part of the pig so there is no wasted protein)! The Mac and Cheese is not pictured, but also a recommended must, saving room for either the Blueberry Buckle or the decadent Chocolate Cake!
New to the area and my first time. Wow, things I haven't seen for years! Yum! However, I found it hard to belive that I was charged extra for a few onions on my sandwich .. really?!

Very basic. The wontons were good and the generals tsaos chicken was good but everything else was very bland. I did not like the shrimp wontons or any other appetizer we got and the Wonton soup tasted soapy.

Worst service ever. Sat in the 2 table to the left. Was waited on by a senior citizen waitress, not even at a crowed time before 0800. The waitress was very slow about taking order from paying customer. Tho the food was good when myself and friend  heated my our plate up in the microwave there after living the restaurant. Waiting 45 mins on food in a sit down restaurant is mad. Ill go there after working a 12 hour shift for a nice hot meal. Never again.

I really hate to give anyone a bad rating, especially during these times. Taziki? That was not made from any kind of yogurt I would ever buy or certainly experience in Greece. The chicken kabobs were dry with no flavor at all. So disappointed!
I had the pulled pork sandwich.  Fantastically seasoned and moist and tender.  Service was fast and friendly.

It's been quite some time since I visited this place and to find the outside and inside had changed so much was a nice surprise. I remember years ago how I loved the pastries and coffee so I was looking forward to that. 
However, after walking in and immediately seeing the sign to seat yourself I was kind of disappointed because I didn't see a coffee bar or pastry case. We all sat down at a table and looked at the menu which again I was disappointed to not see any pastries on the menu but only full meals and quite pricy at that. I ordered the breakfast burrito which turned out to be pretty mediocre. Nothing special, I make better ones myself. My friends seemed to enjoy their meals although nothing was said about how wonderful it was. 
I'm going back tomorrow. After looking at the website it appears that they do have pastries....I'll just have look more carefully. 
Will write more later~
P.S. the service was great!

I used to really like this place...last night may have been an off night. the sushi as always was delish but the chinese was not. the lo mein didnt have much shrimp but lots of onions which changes the flavor.  The boneless ribs were so tough I couldn't chew them and had to throw them out. I hate to waste food.
We went to Thai Basil and got seated right away and after 15 minutes , we still did not have water or had anyone even make eye contact with us.  Terrible Service!   We left.

I love this place. The servers are friendly and remember what I order. Reasonable prices, quick takeout - what's not to love?? The Panang is very peanut-y. The green curry is good with bamboo and eggplant. I love both and those are my go to orders. I also enjoy that pad Thai and I had the fresh rolls. I should branch out but I have to drive to get here so usually make go with tried and true favorites.

Madeline's continues to excel in service and quality. 
All my friends know about Madeline's and a couple in the area are going to be trying it soon. 

Highly recommend a visit and check out their great specials/coupons in their takeout menu!

Update 4/13: just tried their pasta and wings for the first time and both were DELICIOUS! My boyfriend said it's now his go to wing place in Nashville and I'll definitely be ordering pasta when that craving hits again.

I really miss the play area that used to be here since it brings back some nostalgia of taking my son from when he was 1-3 years old to get breakfast in the mornings.  But play areas are a dying commodity in the fast food business.  The only place you'll find them nowadays is a Chic-fil-a.  

Overall, it's just a McDonalds with upgraded technology.  Wish they didn't get rid of the play area though, if Chic-fil-a can do it... just saying.

I'll keep this review short and simple.

Greatest. Tomato. Pie. I've. Ever. Had. 

Service? Terrific
Good? Terrific
Prices? Definitely fair!

Overall rating: 10/10, if you're nearby definitely call and set up an order, you'll never regret it!

Ordered a Hot spicy chicken and did NOT get the same quality (see photo) as what is pictured on the website (see screenshot). Additionally, it was not very good.

Chinese people do not know how to do KOREAN fried chicken right.

For those looking to experience true Korean fried chicken, this place is definitely not the place to experience it.

NOTE: Read Dee Dee H's review. She speaks the truth and is on point with the details. I wish I read her review before ordering...
Great place !! Our sever, Patrick was awesome !! We got the Peyton hamburger and it was delicious. Will definitely go back when we are in town.

I am in love with Philadelphia. Came to support The Barnes Collection and the city. A hotel after eight months of quarantine, hungry for some socially responsible, distanced dining. 

Lucky for us, IndeBlue allowed us a switch from later in the evening to luncheon as thunderclaps and rain was heralded for later in the day. 

We were greeted and cared for by an irrepressibly kind, and professional server, our "blessed" Bennett as we lovingly coined him.  The love of one's fare and the obvious care of creating cuisine with such evident passion for excellence was indisputable. 

Everything was beyond reproach and marvelous. The breezes picked up to make the al fresco dining beneath the black umbrella a most comfortable repast. 

The food itself was quite good, spiced with nuance and subtlety, as all good Indian should be. Not a massacre of flavor, but subtle waltzes between differing spice dance partners. 

We had a lovely time. Before long we befriended the other tables and we were all over the top about Bennett. Thank you Philadelphia. Thank you IndieBlue. Thank you Bennett!

Went to eat here recently for the first time in years. I had the chicken lettuce wraps which were delicious and I highly recommend them. Also got the Asian BBQ ribs which I didn't care for as there was a spice on them I didn't like. Our server graciously exchanged them for some spicy tuna rolls. The rolls were ok but nothing special. The dinner overall was adequate but slightly overpriced for what was ordered. I had a gift card to pay but I can't see myself coming back anytime soon.
Have been going here for years. However, the prices have gone up while food and  service have suffered. Too many other GOOD dinners in the area, skip this one!

Was very excited to try this fairly new restaurant. Went on weekend night and had no trouble parking or being seated. The appetizers were good and came out quickly. The entrees took a while to come out but this time didnt seem long because of the great ambiance of the restaurant.  Great date spot.

This is our first visit to the Maple Street biscuit Company and I'm glad we came here this Sunday afternoon. Their online ordering system was easy to navigate and very helpful in adding extras to the biscuit order. We had fried chicken on a biscuit with goat cheese we had a half dozen cinnamon biscuits that are beyond delicious we also bought scrambled egg plain biscuit egg done well lots of pepper on it perfect. Next time you are thinking about sweet biscuits or biscuits with just about anything on it get out your app and get yourself some fine biscuits here. In addition sweet coffees are welcome with any biscuit.The pricing for each item was extremely fair and even with a few add-ons reasonable amount of money for some solid good food.Grits and hash browns also beg to be next to your biscuits- give them a try!
Great coffee and drink selection .
Homemade jellies and jams.

I was at the one in the King of Prussia Mall on a Friday night, and there was a young woman named "Maya" working there. She was absolutely amazing and should be given some sort of raise. She seemed beyond happy and spoke very clearly and was very helpful. I wanted to tip her, but they don't allow to accept tips. It would be great if a manger could see this and at least let her know she is appreciated.

If you're looking for the best high end sushi place. This is exactly where you should go. Everything is so fresh and delicious! It is super hard to get reservation though so be on the look out on their booking app. It can be frustrated since they are booked very fast but trust me it's worth it!

The atmosphere and the service were good, but I'm not sure why it's so popular? 

We got tamales, enchilada, tacos, cheese grits (those were actually good), and brussel sprouts. We were not impressed by the food at all.

Drinks and food were great! The service was the best part of the experience. We were an annoying big group and the waiters kindly grabbed two tables and an umbrella from across the street and were genuine about it. James was AMAZING and wish I knew the other workers names to put in this review but everyone who worked here were great!
Great service. Good food. It isn't life altering but it has the hometown feel that makes it a great breakfast spot. No turkey bacon....so for those who can't eat pork it's limited

I ordered online for pickup and for the THIRD time ordering from this location they only gave me half a portion in the burrito bowl. When I walk through the line and watch them put the ingredients together this never happens. I called back to inform them they've not given me what I've paid for and they told me the manager was busy and hung up on me. This is not acceptable in a business, so I will not recommend anyone go to this location.

Real New York style, foldable crust pizza.  If what you want is New York style pizza and not a facsimile of it, go here.  I'm from New Jersey.

Go here.

The food we had was sooo good! We enjoyed the outdoor seating while sipping drinks! My roommate got a dessert that looked sooo beautiful and somehow tasted as amazing as it looked, if not more.! I enjoyed the happy hour drinks and the feeling grate mac n cheese. It looked soooo good that I didn't even stop to take a photo  Trust me it's worth every cal! It was such a different type of Mac n Cheese, totally tasted boujee and not the Kraft kind I get at Kroger 
We will Forsure be back! Hopefully I can see the upstairs next time (they had it closed off for a party)
Great downtown Deli!!!! Much needed in the sea of very expensive lunch options.  Prices are reasonable and sandwiches are huge! The chorizo beer cheese soup is amazing!

Great live music! I had such a great time here with my friends last night. We drank cheap beers ($4 Miller Lite), ate good food ($10 Shrimp Taco's) and danced the night away to an awesome band.  The shrimp tacos were awesome! So fresh, so filling. Absolutely perfect. And the music... the best! The band played alot of awesome 70's & 80's rock tunes and a little Bob Marley thrown in the mix. If you want a more casual, less fussy experience than most of the establishments in this area- come to Rogues Gallery!

0 STARS! This horrible experience all started with one person. My fiancé and I had never been here before, and we received coupons in the mail, so we decided to check it out! Our favorite pizza of all time is Chicken, bacon, Artichoke and jalapeños on white sauce. Soooooo that's what we ordered. My fiancé called it in and we started getting excited! So we went to pick it up, and when we walked in our experience was immediately ruined. The girl at the front (who wasn't wearing a name tag) looked up at us and didn't say a word.. she was doing something on the register but still didn't say a word... a whole minute went by and she finally looked up again and said "what can i get you" we said "we have a pick up for Sam" she says "for Seth??" I said for SAM" and she pulls our information up on the computer and tells us our total. Two young gentlemen walk in after us and she was obviously friends with them because she starts talking to them, all while I'm still in front of her. She then tells them "hold on give me a minute" So we give her the coupon and she tells us our total so I complete the transaction.. Then it was SO SHOCKING TO ME WHAT HAPPENED NEXT. She had the AUDACITY TO IMMEDIATELY ASK US "are you waiting for something" UHHM YEAH.. MY FOOD!!!! Are you kidding???? We will NEVER BE BACK... ON TOP OF ALL THAT, our order was wrong. All wrong. They forgot the artichokes and the bacon. So we ate a chicken jalapeño pizza. I'm so disgusted.

My boyfriend and I went to B.GOOD the other night for a healthy and quick dinner. He ordered the chicken/bacon sandwich and bacon Mac and cheese. The food looked amazed; he said it tasted equally as amazing. I ordered the side Caesar salad and the eggplant meatballs. The salad dressing was delicious, however the croutons were very hard (and I am a crouton fanatic). The meatballs were DELICIOUS! I wish the portions were bigger, but I will definitely be back to try more things!

I haven't been to Panini's in years, so I stoped in for a beer and snack after shopping near by. I sat at the bar it was 6:25 on a Tuesday evening. There were five other people sitting there with drinks, although I noticed one mans drink was empty. The two female bartenders were standing at the end of the bar looking at their phones. After waiting four minutes for either of them to acknowledge me, I left.

These are the rudest mfers you will ever meet. 
They act Like you can't ask a simple question. The cheesesteak is awesome. But the employees get irritated so easily and the system it self is inefficient.

Went with my daughter who insisted on buying me breakfast I would appreciate as good as my awesome cooking. She was right!  Great service experience time. Always starts with my coffee and Kale Tonic that I'm hooked on!
Absolutely love this place. But the bathroom smell that comes out to the bar area is disgusting. Sorry.

Recently had a date night with my husband at Forsythia. I was a fan of Will, and was looking forward to our meal here based on other reviews. 

We had a 7pm reservation - and this is probably the most disappointing part of the evening -- we arrived around 6:50 and were not seated until shortly after 7:30. When we arrived, the hostess told us that the table was being set up and suggested we wait a few minutes at the bar. (While we sat at the bar, I looked into the dining room and did not see any available tables.) Twenty minutes later we were told that the diners at our table just got their check and should be leaving soon. I'm sorry, but that is a very different explanation than "your table is being set up." 

Turns out we weren't the only ones who waited over half an hour for their "reservation" as the table next to us told us the same thing happened to them.

Anyhow - the food was fine. I think the late seating put a bad taste in my mouth and I wasn't quite able to shake it off.

Suggestion: don't customize ur bowl because the bowls they have are delicious. I customized my bowl for the first time and it was so bleh compared to their hangover bowl. Ok maybe this is just annoyed to my future self. Buddha bowls has a BOGO thing going on this month so hop on it!  Also the Mac daddy isn't mandatory. Seriously try the other stuff :)
This is worse than a $3 frozen pizza.  Missing toppings (Margherita pizza with no basil?). It's hard to eat. Def not ordering again.

I have to admit, Hamburger Mary's was actually superb. It is pleasant place. Everything was fresh, flavorsome, and totally tasty. Bonus that their service is so very good, they are so fast and helpful. Overall I would go again and recommend the place to friends.
Amazing margaritas and food!  Great customer service, the server was very attentive!  Can't wait to go back with my friends!
I have been craving sushi for a while near me and this place is just perfect.  The food is fast, consistant and high quality.

Ijji 4 aka Ijji Korea is a favorite of both my husband (an unregenerate carnivore) and myself (less carniverous, but still likes good meat).  If you haven't ever eaten at a Korean grill before, recommended.  

This type of restaurant provides you with a variety of meats that you cook over a grill in the middle of your table.  The spicy pork and the chicken tenders are my favorites, but there are a bunch of choices of both meat and seafood.  There's also a selection of good sides (included with the "all you can eat" meals), and a good menu of appetizers.  The meal isn't cheap, but is less expensive than many places that aren't nearly as good.
Disgusting place my friend got E. coli over it when we asked to talk to a manager by getting there earlier they keep making up close times because they don't want to keep working.

I've never been to the physical location, but I've been ordering from them regularly during the COVID pandemic.  I'm amazed by their hibachi delivery. At most hibachi places I've been to in the past, the food isn't nearly as good as delivery as it is in the restaurant, but Kabuto does this well.  The food arrives hot and tastes delicious, and you get everything you would have gotten if you'd gone to the physical location.  If you're in the mood for hibachi but don't want to go out, Kabuto is an excellent choice.

Disappointing. Service was terrible--we were basically ignored. Biscuit was over cooked and mediocre at best. Aren't we in the South?  The pancake was ok. We ordered chocolate chip, but it only had a few chocolate chips and the texture could have been better.

This was my first trip to the Full Belly Deli ... it was delicious.

Wide variety of hot & cold sandwiches ... all reasonably priced.  Several salad options, and even a Little Bellies (Children's) Menu.

Ordered a Cuban and it was ginormous ... had to take half of it home to finish later ... so go hungry.

Their breads are "house made," and they do have Gluten Free options.

And they serve breakfast all day.  And of course, you can get a few Wrap options too.

Although they did have potato chips, I would have enjoyed a coleslaw or potato salad option ... but this won't keep me from going back.

In the mood for a "big sandwich," ... then check this place out.  There is also one on Mill Street and one in Truckee CA.

Was on my way to desire oyster bar for breakfast but arrived to late and they were not serving again until 1130 so I walked down  Bourbon street trying to find a breakfast spot then I stumbled on this place no breakfast but they had frog legs which I love so I went in and this place was on point!!!!!!
The alligator bites were on point and the frog legs were just as good as the ones I had in Paris!!!!!
The Bourbon street punch was good and the ribs were on point. Service was good very attentive!!!!!!
This is my first time in New Orleans but trust when I come back this place will get my business!!!!!!!
I was very disappointed in my food quality. I didn't enjoy the oysters at all they were horrible. My daughter had hair in her food. Its was disgusting

Great little place to eat , grabbed a philly cheese steak, A 14 inch white pizza with spinach on it , these guys are the real deal . Great food , quiet little place was really rocking tonight
STOP BY & CHECK THEM OUT , 
Say hi to Tony

Food is completely over rated. It's a salt, sugar and grease bomb. The quality is supposed to be good but it's ruined by the way it's cooked and treated. The buns are good though. Food is also over priced for the amount of food you get. Would rather go to elevation burger so I can pick my toppings and they also have grass fed beef for better prices.
This place is insane absolutely mind blowing insane to the membrane will definitely return
High class without being snooty. Classic Louisiana. Delicious seafood. Heard they have great brunch too, but unfortunately never got around to it! Sweet atmosphere, like an old living room.
Very cute drive thru, fun happy music while waiting. A little pricey but most healthy food places are. Had the caprese toast, very fresh ingredients. Friend likes the avocado toast as well.

Ice cream machine worked! Friendly lady up front. But management needs to work on employees on break inside the facility. Very distasteful language, volume, etc. No one came out to quite the down or correct the vulgarities, racist remarks, or heckling.

Bruh these wings are straight booty. Literally so soft I feel like I'm eating bird covered in extra sauce (not the good kind). I would rather walk to BDubs than eat at this establishment. You are welcome for the review.
The grouper tacos lived up to the hype! Loved the queso! Jason is a great cook and extremely nice! We came from PA and just had to try it, we'll be back.
I recommend adding Willie Mae's to your must see list.  The entrees will remind you of Sunday dinner as a child.

Think Bon Air and you know it's about Fast Eddie's!

Where else can the food for two people be less than $10 and tasty! 

Grab a table, order a Big Elwood on a stick and a cheeseburger then go enjoy the coldest beer in town!

Bring CASH as Fast Eddie's is CASH ONLY!
So far, everything has been good. They have traditional Vietnamese food but also some interesting fusion items. Will absolutely return.

Looking for a brunch place over a weekend and having tried most of the favorites in the tampa area, my wife and I decided  to give Babushka's a try. Located in a strip mall, the interiors are nicely done. Our family of four, including a noisy infant and a toddler, got the salmon bruschetta, lamb dumplings, farmers cheese pancakes and the mushroom thin pancakes. The mushroom pancakes were my favorite.  All of the food was extremely authentic and the service was very friendly and prompt. Recommend this place if you want a taste of Russian fare.
Love this place! Food is consistently delicious with friendly service. Keto menu is awesome!

Stopped by on our way through Nashville. We ordered a full rack of ribs and pulled pork, with green beans and macaroni for sides. Not much conversation at the table, only the sound of food inhaled. The ribs fell off the bone, pork was juicy and flavorful. The green beans were full of flavor and the Mac and cheese was rich and creamy. Holy hell Batman, everything was amazing! You can't go wrong here.

Very tasty and packaged well for take away. Even the calamari was good once we got it home which can be a tricky feat to have calamari hold well for a take out order. Gnocchi was delicious, almost as good as being in Italy!

I come from New York State, so I couldn't give a Midwest pizza place 5 stars. It's just not possible. The pizza here, even at the best places, isn't as good than my home state's pizza, and that's ok. That being said, this is my favorite delivery place. The wings are good sized and the pizza is actually pretty good. They're also always super nice on the phone and at the door. Just friendly. It's nice. One time, they forgot part of my order and were great about it. I just called to let them know and they offered three options: refund, credit for that item on my account, bring the item to me immediately. I went with the credit and sure enough, a few weeks later, I ordered and they asked if I wanted to include the free item from last time or leave it on my account for another time. They just really know how to hold onto their customers. I've become a loyal customer because, A) they CLEARLY make customer satisfaction a priority, and B) (let's just be honest) the hot glazed wings and funnel cake fries

I was offered a buy one get one free chicken parm entree, and seek as this is a favorite in my family- we gladly took them up on their offer. Ordering was easy online. When you pull up- they bring the food out to your car. This was our first time and I found this process good. They also put the food containers in a pizza box to make for easier transporting-  very thoughtful. 

The first thing I noticed was the extremely strong smell of raw red onions. The salads has so many red onions on it- and they were so smelly it seemed they may have sat for a while. I don't know for sure because I don't enjoy raw onions and the amount and odor were completely off-putting. The chicken parm itself was extremely thin... and soaked in so much sauce it became soggy. There were points where there was no chicken and just breading I was eating (like paper thin chicken- all breading no chicken!) The pasta was doughy- which maybe means it was made fresh. It wasn't my favorite- but my family loved it. The sauce was good. Personally, I would try other dishes here- but I found the chicken parm underwhelming. 

While yes, I did receive one of these meals for free- the meals themselves cost $18, and I am not certain that the meal is worth that much!

alright now i'll start out by saying yes, it is still burrito lover i know many of you are probably confused because burritos are my specialty but trust me you'll wanna tune in for this one. And again after a long day of losing i had to sacrifice chipotle and choose olive garden. First off I was really impressed with how short the wait was, but i won't give them too much credit because it was a sunday afternoon. Took a hot minute to get us our first batch of bread which was irritating but i looked past it. we had to keep asking for bread even tho we made sure our waitress knew that our table would be eating a lot of bread.. in the middle of eating i felt my heart jump out of place as our waitress had just dropped a huge stack of porcelain plates right next to J dawg!! ridiculous!! mind you she had already dropped a water cup a table over from us!! not even 5 minutes later the other waitress helping our waitress dropped the food tray and it even hit J dawg!! at this point i was in total awe!! it's like we were being targeted. then. wait for it. i don't know if you're going to believe this. in the car we realized. our waitress. FORGOT OUR MINTS. THE MINTS THAT OLIVE GARDEN IS KNOWN FOR. i can consciously say i hope she gets fired. surprise. another loss. and this time it happily wasn't chipotle. it was olive garden. absolute rubbish if u ask me.

Doc's has changed locations but has the same delicious food and fast, friendly service. It's not far from the former spot, and you can still smell that smokey bbq goodness from the parking lot. The dining area has at least  doubled in size, and the new layout allows for quick counter service. There is even a separate entrance for carryout and catering orders. You can't go wrong with pulled pork, brisket, burnt ends, mac 'n' cheese, green beans and potato salad. The nachos are wonderful too...Heck, the entire menu is great. This is definitely my bbq go-to spot. God bless Doc and his staff!

I have 5 words for you: ALL. YOU. CAN. EAT. SUSHI! This is definitely the way to go if you have a sushi craving. The menu is designed that you can mark off what you want and how many orders you want, just be careful and make sure you're matching the food and ordering line correctly! (We accidentally ordered 3 bowls of fried rice instead of whatever was above/below it lol) I definitely recommend coming here with at least a small group that way you can get lots of different variety to try. The all you can eat is about $30 per person, and try to make sure that you don't have leftovers because the restaurant can/will charge extra to take them home. There is limited parking at the back of the restaurant, but you may have to park a little ways away if the lot is full. Overall, a great experience!

It's a really nice place and then the wine options very odd. 3 ounce pour or 6 ounce pour.  No bottle list. The Waiter said take the 6 ounce pour X 4 to get the price.  Made our table uncomfortable.  Clearly a benefit to the house and not the consumer. Nice place like this should have a diverse wine list of product and price.  Oysters were really good.  Fish dishes were really good. Had to ask the server twice what the special was - he had to go back a couple times to look it up.  Sides were really good.  Multiple people came to our table to check in on us for water, food, drinks. Very attentive.  Feeling from the table was pour the wine, we will order a lot more. When measured every step of the way it's a turn off.   Really good atmosphere.  Hope the restaurant makes adjustments and does really well.
I'm Vietnamese and this place sucks. There's better places to go down the street!! The kitchen is nasty . Don't belive me.Take a peek! Haha don't say I didn't warned u

New and hot place.  First time trying Portuguese food. Ordered at counter and the food is brought out to your table.  The chicken was flame grilled and delicious--spicier than expected in the mild sauce but the garlic ranch sauce helped toned it down. The cassava fries were delicious.  The falafels were flavored with the lemon and herb sauce.  They were delicious.  Overall a good meal and will try lamb chops next time.

Online ordering and pick up was super easy and the food was ready by the time we got there. The wings were really good and not too saucy! The flavors were distinct. I especially enjoyed the sriracha lemon pepper wings. The fries aren't my favorite in the city but they were fine. We didn't eat there but they had a cute outdoor area (I believe the chairs were tilted because of the summer rain that day) I want to come back to try more flavors!

This was probably the worst offering of Caribbean food I ever tasted.  Being a first generation New Yorker from Trinidad, I can distinguish authentic Trinidadian flavors from individuals trying to make a quick buck.  This was a "quick buck" experience.  I had the stew chicken and my wife had the oxtail.  The stew chicken tasted and looked like they took a can of beans and ground beef (chilli), added some more seasonings to it and then added chicken tenders...terrible.  The oxtail was also an equally awful offering.  The one positive was the friendly wait staff.

They're back open! This is our go to Chinese place. We love the empress chicken and potstickers (amazing sauce that is sweet, tangy, a bit spicy, and packs a garlicky punch). The service is wonderful with people that truly get to know you.

I am currently on a business trip to the Edmonton area from California. I was looking for a new place to eat dinner when I remembered having a great experience at Fumaca on a previous visit just a few months ago. 

While I could not remember the gentleman's name, one of the servers had made recommendations for me to try that he thought I might like. I remember that he was intent on making sure I had a positive experience. 

I returned to Fumaca today with the memory and recognized the server from my previous visit. Again, he went out of his way to recommend the mint sauce to try with the lamb. He even went to get it for me. 

This time I asked his name and am happy to say that Raj is truly an asset to Fumaca. He has exemplary customer service skills and goes the extra mile to make sure his patrons have a special time. 

The next time I'm in Edmonton, I will not hesitate to come back. 

Thank you Raj and all the staff here for making my experiences good ones.
Delicious poke bowls and fast service. I got the classic Hawaiian bowl and it was amazing. This will definitely become a regular spot for me!
I have gone back to Pizza Amore severs times and it is so much better.  The grandma pie is awesome!  Just allow enough time because it takes roughly an hour.

My fiancé and I stopped here for dinner before seeing a show at the Fox. We arrived to find that the restaurant is no longer affiliated David Burke and that there is a completely new menu, that's fine but I wish there was some kind of indication online that they had changed management (and the menu). We started off with the Duck Croquette appetizer which was fantastic! Other than the croquettes the experience was not all that great. I ordered the fish sandwich (cod) and when it arrived I couldn't tell it had fish on it, it was so thin all I could taste was bread, tartar sauce and pickles. My fiancé ordered the salmon with beet risotto. The beet risotto was okay, nothing special but the salmon was so disappointing, it was flavorless. We were not offered a dessert menu so im not sure if they have dessert. We still had some time to kill after the entrees so fiancé ordered a cup of tea. The server arrived with mint tea even though he ordered green tea. We probably won't be back, too expensive for bland food.

One of my fave things to do is to hang out with great company and delicious food!
One of the best ways to do this is to sit, drink, and enjoy tapa dishes that slowly trickle in as you chat away and catch up on what's happening in your lives. 
Bodega is one of the best tapa places in the city. Any of their locations are great!
I especially love their Iberico and manchego cheese is a great way to start. Their chicken liver smoked duck pâté is fabulous. Their braised boar cheeks and grilled octopus was memorable for sure! Just try it all!
Just be careful during the hot summer seasons. 
As much as I love sitting in the sun, it can get pretty hot inside the Highlands location. So, choose a seat further in to avoid the hot sun beaming in the window during service. 
Highly recommend!

This is the best place to eat on the entire island if you are looking for great food at reasonable prices. Most other places around here are just cash cows that don't give a hoot about the quality of food or service. Frenchy's is tops! The grouper sandwich is the best I've had in this area! It came out hot right out of the fryer and was juicy and flaky just the way I like it.Servers wear masks and are courteous and prompt.

Some of the best Thai food I have ever had. The curry of the day, it was Massaman, was creamy, hot, and a huge portion. While I was only visiting Nashville, the next time I'm back, I'm going to make sure I visit on Massaman day again!

Not a very cool spot if you've ever been to Anaheim Packing District in Orange County or Grand Central Market in Los Angeles. The food is overpriced and underwhelming. I wish I went somewhere else. The place is loud, crowded, and seems to attract rather unhappy people. I probably wouldn't go back.

We ordered dinner to share for two; chicken chimichangas appetizer, pork carnitas street tacos, chips, guacamole, salsa and a side of beans. Everything was delicious!! Would definitely order those items again and I saw a couple of menu items that we want to try next time.
Very nice cafe in the heart of downtown.  Staff is always friendly with great coffee.  Don't miss this gem!

Came here with the family because the outdoor seating looked spacious and seemed to have a decent amount of shade from the afternoon sun. 

Ordered a one of their dramatic bloody Mary's. It looked cool but tasted like crap. It was just pure tomato juice with a whole bunch of salt/pepper mixed in. I couldn't drink more than like 5 sips before I sent it back. 

Our food took forever to come out and when it did, I wish it wouldn't have. I ordered the scorpion burger, medium.... it came out fully cooked, maybe even a little burnt. It was also extremely sloppy looking and I think it was missing half the items that were supposed to be on it. My fries were cold. 

My husband ordered the impossible burger. He said the impossible burger at Burger King tasted better, he was lying. It was awful. His fries were also cold. 

The GM was super nice and accommodating. The server was as well. There was an error when we first came in. She didn't see us seated and started servicing the tables that arrived after us. 

Overall, I would never come back here. They have a lot of beers and the place looks clean and kept up.

Ptomain Changs!  Perhaps the worst restaurant experience in the last 10 years!!!  Don't eat here!  Beware!!!  Under cooked chicken, an hour wait after ordering!  Dirty table, stoned waitress forgot to put in our order, greasy signature dish!  Really disappointing fall from a former good reputation!
Waste of time and money in the new wasteland around the galleria.
Love the food & the specialty drinks. Hope people are supporting and ordering through this time.

Pick Up
Placed the order at 7:50. Was told to arrive at 8:20. Waiting now at 8:40 and order is still not ready. I'll NEVER order Pick Up again! After reading the reviews, I see I should have done my homework prior! I hope others do their homework in future, and don't make the same mistake I did.

I have lost faith in yelp reviews after trying this place.  I really do not know what my orange "chicken" was comprised of but it in no way resembled or had the texture of any chicken I had ever tried.  Unless it was made up of what was leftover from McDonalds and Burger King after they make their chicken nuggets?

Just thinking about this makes me want to go lick a laundromat floor just to get the taste out of my mouth. 
The rangoons were good, so they get one star.  

I guess I'll stick with Panda.  At least there I know what to expect.

I went to Bienvenue a few weeks ago with my fiancé and had the best experience! The atmosphere is very laid back, waiters were extremely friendly, and the food was delicious! I ordered the fried oyster poboy, and I have to say, one of the BEST I've had!! The portion of oysters that they put on the sandwich was very generous, and they tasted delicious! Not greasy at all. And the French bread was not too hard. Truly one of the best poboys I've had in the New Orleans area. Can't wait to go back!

The lady and I were in town on a little get away day trip from LA. This place looked very interesting and elegant so we decided to dine, I'm glad we did.

First and foremost, the staff are incredibly friendly and accommodating. Our waiter, Keegan, was so polite and friendly. This is sometimes hard to come by in LA but I feel should just be the norm! Nonetheless I was impressed.

We ordered The Chop, it's basically a big salmon salad with quinoa, tomatoes, beats, and avocado. DELICIOUS!!

For drinks, Grace got the mimosa, which is worth noting that comes with one free refill, and I got the Santa Barbara Spritz. 

This place well exceeded our expectations and is highly recommended to any that pass through.

The only downside I would say is that the menu was a little short. I understand that everything is seasonal as it is mostly a seafood restaurant, but I still would have liked to see a few more options.

Overall I give it a 4.3

This place is our new favorite go to! So good it rivals all the Korean food in California. We had the bulgogi bim bam bop, the bulgogi tacos, and the LA style Kalbi beef ribs. Everything, all the sides/toppings are amazing! So much to choose from! The Kalbi ribs are so delectable you want to eat them all alone in dark room so you don't have to share! Their sauces are phenomenal as well. Try them all. They have special red pepper sauce, miso marmalade etc. Oh and try the Korean fried chicken. I would get it tossed in the sauce but that's just me. They're homemade kimchi is excellent as well. And....this is all super affordable.  Like $10-12 an entree! Get on this place, it is a homerun!

I'll give this place 5 for service and 5 for food quality although they are sometimes inconsistent in the preparation of dishes. Overall excellent ambiance and the quiche is a must try. Highly recommend for local breakfast.

What's a party without a donut bar?? The donut bar is only as good as the donuts you put out it. We always get Doughboys. I have ordered special colors, special sprinkles, etc. to match the event or holiday. Always a hit!

With plenty of good breakfast/brunch spots in the Fishtown/Northern Liberties area, it took me awhile to get to around to Honey's Sit-N-Eat. They, however, did not disappoint. 

My group of three arrived at 8:30AM on a Sunday morning and were immediately seated. I should warn though that a decent sized line started to form at the end of our breakfast - for good reason! Once seated, we were promptly greeted by our server with bottomless La Colombe coffee and recommendations from their daily special menu.  The restaurant staff was very attentive throughout with the table's coffee and water supplies never reaching the bottom. I was pleased with the friendly, homey environment. 

For the most part, the food was fantastic. We ordered the freshly baked blueberry muffin from the specials per the server's recommendation. Wow. Absolutely delicious. The muffin was short on blueberries, however, the crunchy top combined with a moist, buttery balance on the inside made for a scrumptious starter. My order of the Country Fried Steak was the only reason Honey's gets 4-stars. The steak was fried to a perfectly lightly flaky consistency, but the gravy and breading seasoning were absolutely bland. The steak only served as a plate filler for the sides, which were much better. My sides were a latke, buttered biscuit, and eggs-over-hard (that was a silly mistake on my end). The latke was so delicious - crunchy outside with a delicate, cheesy(?) inside! The biscuit was good with a little extra but

I always pass this place whenever I'm in Philly, so it's always been on my list of places to try. I've actually been here twice now and it's one of the places I recommend to friends if they have not tried it yet. The place is actually bigger than you'd think a hotdog place would be. They have hightop seating, then regular seating, and even a section with vintage arcade games! The staff is always friendly and they are very on top of their work. Their menu of hotdogs was honestly so overwhelming cause there were so many choices of different types of hotdogs from different states and countries. I probably read over the menu 10 times before actually deciding on one. I ordered one of their specialty dogs the first time, and I was pretty satisfied with it. I couldn't really find a hotdog that had everything I liked on it, but I just sucked it up and hoped I would like what I ordered. The beef hotdog itself was really good, and the bread was not like your typical hotdog bread. It also comes with kettle chips on the side, which I personally like over french fries. The second time around, I custom made my hotdog, which was better for me because I'm a picky eater. Even though a hotdog doesn't sound like a lot, I was pretty full after just eating one. My only issue is that both times I've been here, I've always gotten a stomach ache from the food. I think it's probably from all the grease and oil they use to cook their food, and I just have a weak stomach. But the overall taste of their
Stopped by with my husband to have a burger and try their beer and we were pleasantly surprised at how great the food and beer was! The atmosphere was also great! Can't wait to go back

Not sure why this place has such good reviews. It was very pricey, especially for the portion sizes that you get and the order took forever to be ready. Ordered the large tom kha which was $13, it barely had any broth, had huge chunks of inedible lemongrass and some pieces of chicken and mushrooms, and the container was only like 1/4 full. So I essentially paid for lemongrass that went straight into the trash. Ordered the gaeng kiew, $12, tasted like watered down green curry, tofu in boiled water with a couple pieces of undercooked eggplant thrown in there, again it was like 1/4 full. The coconut water which they charged $4 for was a joke, a store bought frozen jar of overly sweet coconut flavored syrup that's supposed to be "coconut water". The only item that was good was the pad see-ew.
My boyfriend and I love crepes and coming here didn't disappoint. Really simple and organized menu which makes ordering easy. Prices are extremely reasonable. We will be back.
Good food good service more choice than Han Dynasty dumplings in chilly sauce were excellent

I had this restaurant on my radar for a while so when my hubby had a taste for catfish one Saturday afternoon, I decided to place a takeout order. From what I can tell, all orders are tracked by phone number and then name. We ordered the King Catfish platter which was just enough for both of us. Delicious, delectable catfish-my mouth is watering thinking about it ha! 

Now, under COVID restrictions you can order ahead for curbside pick up or place a takeout order from the parking lot. I usually get the catfish (of course) and plan to try the chargrilled oysters. Looking forward to my next meal from Barrow's.

I literally stumbled upon this place on my way to UPS. It's small but it's cute, my waiter was blah but he makes amazing drinks. The female waiter was super sweet tho!  The food was good the drinks were even better! I got lucky and I met some cool people. 

The only thing I didn't like was the out door seating but I think they just opened up on dining again so I won't hold you to that.

Had been meaning to go here for a while, and in my book it's not the best but not the worst pho. Boise pho is lack luster but I think this is better than the one on 8th or the one off Broadway. I definitely liked the vibe--intimate and cozy, and it was perfect for the rainy day. Would probably go back again, but will definitely try others before that happens.
This place is amazing. The staff are so warm and friendly and everything I tried was delicious. I highly recommend the chocolate cherry bread. I will be stopping in more often!
The service here is so amazing. I have always had great service here. The food is to die for and the price is so reasonable. If you want a delicious taco and high quality service, you must come here.

This palce was unfortunately 2 stars. I wont be coming back. My meat was dry. No taste. Their version of a quesadilla was not what I expected. It was a small flour tortilla with pico de gallo, cheese some green sauce with no taste and a hard crunchy tortilla on top. I asked the lady what it was she said its a quesadilla. I told her I never seen something like this before. I asked her if she had regular quesadillas and rudely said no this is what we offered And closed the door on me. Bad customer service.

I am a fan of Bryn and Dane's! It is a casual place with a lovely botanical atmosphere. It is a very vegan and vegetarian friendly place. The order kiosks are nice and convenient; in all the times that I've been there I've never had to wait to order. The food does take a while to come out, though. But it is comforting that the kitchen area is pretty open so you can see them preparing your food. I have had the sweet potato fries many times and they are delicious, but the most recent time they were still slightly frozen (hot on the outside and cold on the inside.) I don't have a problem with them using fries that are frozen, but I expect them to be heated thoroughly, especially if they take a while to come out.

Consistently amazing!  I could go to fancier but the food in this little place is so delicious, fresh and unlike any other. Order the agedashi tofu and chirashi bowl and you won't be sorry. The texture of the tofu is sublime and the cuts on the pieces In the bowl are so thick. I'm always so disappointed when I order these dishes at other Japanese places. We also supplement our orders with uni - among the creamiest and freshest I've ever had.

Love the food, I always order the same thing (chipotle chicken tacos) and it's always so good..the reason for my 4 stars is, I always order an extra side or two of the chipotle ranch and they charge me .50 cents for them and they are always less than half full. I feel that if they're going to charge me money for the sauce it should be all the way full..it happens every time.

It can be hard to find a brewery that does both beer and food well - but this place excels!  Their Heatwave Hefeweizen is delightful while washing down a great bbq sandwich.  Perfect stop after a hike up Sentinel Peak, and it's not too far from the trail.

Five stars for masking, asking customers to be masked, and safe handling of everything.  3 stars because the food is just okay. This was our third visit.  Like another reviewer, our lettuce was wilted.  Too many options for chicken salad, and they do get them mixed up, or seem to be missing a key ingredient. This last visit, the tables weren't bussed, and we had to wait because as you'd expect, seating very limited. Napkin dispensers were empty ... had to search for a full one.  We only ordered scoops, but the wait was ridiculous considering only one customer was waiting for his to-go order, and one other table was occupied. This was early afternoon, not during a lunch rush. When our food finally came, I politely asked if they had had to make more and was told "no." So, don't know what the hold up was.  PDK Pantry's scoops are much better, even though they offer just one chicken salad, and much cheaper, especially on their Special Day.  Despite the drawbacks, at least it is an option that's a little different.

I've been a Starbucks customer for a long time and this location is THE WORST!!! I pay way to much to get no whipped cream with my order and they NEVER make the coffees right! I order a frapp everyday and it's never right from this location, it's always watery and taste horrible!! I also order double shots and you can tell they don't put them in my frapp cause it doesn't even taste like it does when I get from other locations. I always get extra whipped cream and They always say They have no whipped cream. They need to hire new staff and not take orders if they don't have the proper ingredients to make the order!

I don't even know where to begin... let's start here.. When I took my first bite, I was instantly appeared back in Thailand... this is as authentic as it comes.

Fast forward to reality. I was looking for some really good, "curl up and lounge on a Friday night" type of food.. I stumbled across this place but only by the grace of God. .... and boy oh boy am I happy. The food was amazing. I ordered via phone. Thai fried rice with chicken, drunken noodles with beef and the crispy wontons. Every single thing was amazing!! Last year I went to Thailand, and it took me back. Thai food is very pure and the food lets the flavors have "solos in unison".  This place did all that and above. A Plus was making it home and there still being steam! I will definitely be back... And OFTEN!! I'm sooo happy to have cake across this place!
So happy to see this restaurant open. Great food and great staff. Come with an appetite. :)
Pretty decent spot for breakfast. Usually packed and service a little slow. Bacon is kind of skimpy and eggs are bland but nothing salt and pepper can't adjust. Worth a try.

I'm disappointed. Back in July I asked if they could cater for my wedding they said yes and advised what I wanted and how long of a notice do I need to give them. The lady said "oh only 2 weeks" perfect right! The wedding isn't until the end of September. Last weekend we visited again and another lady gave us a card for the lady who handles catering. We've tried calling for a week everyday all through the day we get a ring or two then takes us to a voicemail that they say they don't check or a busy signal. The number on the card is the same as the restaurant... I've tried to email and it gets shot back as the email is not valid and also tried to message on Facebook with no response. I found it very rude that now we are 17 days away and no one will answer.
Food was great and servicing sizes are big, service was excellent (friendly staff and the food came out super fast). Great environment inside with cute decor. Location is also prime.

DAN DAN is one of the best Szechuan Restaurants around. However, I got the beef noodle soup today and was completely shocked at the amount of oil. I get it, it's "Szechuan style" but it's literally like 40% oil in the broth. Please use less of it or offer a version without so we can drink the flavorful broth that makes this dish great.
Nice environment with a good air flow. Great drinks. Goid location. The corn is not that great...don't order it.
Trying a new spot for our anniversary. This was a pleasant surprise. Quaint dining, friendly staff, all round good experience. Not your typical menu and the food is bomb!

I love everything at Rumbi but the Sweet Pork salad is the best salad in town. It's loaded with goodness and the pork is incredible. The bowls are a must as well but upgrade to a Rumbi rice. Beans and rice are delicious! I only eat zucchini here too. Teriyaki sauce is the best. I could drink it here!

Had a great experience for a PA pizza spot. Me being a New Yorker who now lives in Ohio, this pizza was really good. I had a regular and white slice which was perfectly heated up correctly to my liking. It really hit the spot for a pizza fanatic. I did step out of my zone, got a pizza with hamburger meat and white cheese on top (sorry I don't the name) but it wasn't good to my liking. I'll just to the originals. Serves was very friendly,  I will be back!

This is by far the best Sonny's my family has been to! We would drive to this location before the one on Dale Mabry closed.  We visited tho past Friday. Our waitress was wonderful! We were seated a little after 6 and were out before 7. Our food was fresh and so yummy!
